thread:
sam (ml): Started canary for harrow12b yesterday with per-tensor int8 + activation scaling. Seeing two issues: (1) coherence drop on multi-turn instructions (esp >8 turns) and (2) intermittent OOMs when prefetched windows overlap across concurrent sessions. Repro notes below.

mike (infra): Logs point to big KV spikes during prefetch overlap. Error snippet: 
```
2026-03-19T02:14:05Z ERROR cuda error: out of memory
  at prefetch_kv_batch(...)
  at handle_request(...)
  at worker_loop(...)
```
No single huge allocation, more like many medium allocs piling up.

ada (serving): (typing) I recommend: shrink prefetch_window from 1024 -> 512, enable compact_on_idle=true, and switch allocator to cudaMallocAsync. Also lower default max_new_tokens to 400 for onboarding. That should reduce steady-state KV pressure.

tess (evals): Quick quality snapshot vs harrow12b-fp16: BLEU -1.4 on our dialog-turn suite, perplexity +1.5. The coherence drop correlates with long prefix with lots of entity references. Running 3k-turn sweep (dialog-long subset).

kai (sre): Repro on 48GB node with concurrency 10 + prefetch=1024 = OOM within 30s. With prefetch=512 reproduction rate drops to ~10%. Suggest soft session cap at 4096 total tokens and emergency fallback to harrow8b-LITE when mem pressure detected.

sam (ml): Also noticed throughput drop when batch size >6 under this quant profile. Suggest default batching_target=18ms window, target_batch=5, max_batch=10. Keeps latency acceptable while avoiding big simultaneous KV work.

ada (serving): Patch ready. Runtime config diff: 
```
runtime.config.prefetch_window = 512
runtime.config.default_max_new_tokens = 400
runtime.config.batching_target_window_ms = 18
runtime.config.batching_target_batch = 5
runtime.config.batching_max_batch = 10
runtime.config.compact_on_idle = true
allocator.use_cudamallocasync = true
runtime.config.kv_align_mb = 1
soft.session_token_cap = 4096
```
Rolling to canary (5 hosts) now for 3h.

deploy-bot: rollout started: r-2026-1778001234-1 -> canary (5/25).

mike (infra): After first hour: p50 latency = 200ms (was 160ms), p95 = 540ms (was 460ms). Memory baseline dropped ~6GB, max observed 40GB (was 48GB). No new OOMs so far.

tess (evals): Interim eval (1k/3k done): BLEU gap narrowed to -0.5 for dialog-long, coherence issues still present in ~3% of cases (entities muddled). Will surface examples.

ada (serving): Added a fallback rule: if mem_frag_score > 0.08 or allocator error seen twice in 60s then divert that session to harrow8b-lite; also throttle prefetch concurrency.

kai (sre): Action items: 
- ada: continue canary and enable mem_frag_score metric (new gauge).
- tess: finish 3k sweep and post failing prompt samples.
- sam: update onboarding defaults & docs about int8 caveats for multi-turn.
- mike: add dashboard with prefetch_alloc_rate and bump alert severity if average prefetch_alloc_rate > 200MB/s for 5m.

sam (ml): Repro command (local):
```
rcli bench --model harrow12b \
  --quant per-tensor-int8 \
  --prefetch 1024 \
  --concurrency 10 \
  --batch 8 \
  --max_new_tokens 1024 \
  --seq 8192 \
  --allocator cuda_async \
  --out ./harrow12b-prefetch-oom.log
```
(Use prefetch=512 to emulate patched runtime).

tess (evals): Preliminary: with patched defaults (prefetch=512, max_new_tokens=400) BLEU gap down to -0.2 and coherence failures ~0.8%. Full report ETA ~2h.

ada (serving): If final eval looks good and 3h canary has zero OOMs, we'll promote patch. We'll keep the reduced onboarding defaults for int8 profiles and add a checklist: "run 3k dialog-long eval + prefetch stress test" before production rollout.

mike (infra): Noted. If problems reappear after rollout, plan B: enable per-host prefetch-stagger (phase shift timers) + kv_trim-on-evict. Also consider aligning medium allocs to 1MB boundaries in allocator.

sam (ml): Thanks team. Post examples when tess has them and we'll decide on broader rollout after full eval and 3h stability window. :white_check_mark:
